### Where to Change Suffix Formatting and Joining

The suffix formatting and joining logic is located in **[`Option.get_help_record`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py#L3246-L3262)** in [`src/click/core.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py):

```python
extra = self.get_help_extra(ctx)
extra_items = []
if "envvars" in extra:
    extra_items.append(
        _("env var: {var}").format(var=", ".join(extra["envvars"]))
    )
if "default" in extra:
    extra_items.append(_("default: {default}").format(default=extra["default"]))
if "range" in extra:
    extra_items.append(extra["range"])
if "required" in extra:
    extra_items.append(_(extra["required"]))

if extra_items:
    extra_str = "; ".join(extra_items)
    help = f"{help}  [{extra_str}]" if help else f"[{extra_str}]"
```

- **In Click's source code:** Edit lines [3246–3262](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py#L3246-L3262) in [`Option.get_help_record`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py#L3220).
- **In user code (without modifying Click):** Subclass [`click.Option`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py#L2785) and override [`get_help_record(self, ctx)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/click-click-flash-systematic-0/src/click/core.py#L3220) to change how `extra_items` are assembled, formatted, joined, or bracketed.
